request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Do not really delete a project. Just tuck it away so it drops off my lists. Keep it off the
main project list and off the list on the client's page. I do not want to lose anything.
Note it when I do.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is complete and the test passes. Here's a summary of the full-stack implementation.

## What I built

Projects are now **archived** (tucked away, retained) rather than deleted — they drop off both lists, archiving is audited, and a toggle can reveal them again. Nothing is lost.

**Database** — `V15__projects_archived.sql`: adds an `archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` column to `projects`, so every existing project stays active.

**Server (OfficeFloor REST)**
- `Project.java`: new `archived` field + accessors.
- `ProjectsGetLogic.java`: `GET /api/projects` now includes `archived` on each row so the front-end can filter.
- `ProjectsArchiveLogic.java` + `projects/archive.POST.yml`: new `POST /api/projects/archive` endpoint — sets the flag, **keeps the row** (`projects.save`), and appends the audit record `PROJECT_ARCHIVED id=<id>` via the `Audit` service (404 if the project doesn't exist).

**Front-end (all additive new files, plus list-filter wiring)**
- `projects.ts`: `archived` on the `Project` type and a `useArchiveProject` mutation that invalidates `['projects']`.
- `archiveProject.slot.tsx`: new row action `project-archive-<id>` filling the existing `ProjectRow` slot (the Delete action is left untouched).
- `slots/defs/projectsToolbar.ts` + `showArchived.slot.tsx`: a new toolbar region and a `projects-show-archived` toggle that owns a `showArchived` URL search param.
- `ProjectList.tsx`: renders the toolbar and hides archived rows unless `showArchived` is set (same pattern as the invoices status filter).
- `ClientProjects.tsx`: the client's page also filters out archived projects.

The two lists and the toggle coordinate only through the shared `['projects']` query key and the `showArchived` URL param — no cross-feature imports, consistent with the app's conventions.

Test result: `1 passed` — archiving hides `project-row-1`, records `PROJECT_ARCHIVED id=1`, and the toggle brings the row back.
